meaning:
Σαμαρείτης
(-ίτης, Τ; see WH, App., 154; BI., § 3, 4), -ον, ό,
a Samaritan, i.e. an inhabitant of the city or the region of Samaria, in NT always the latter (see: Σαμαρία): Mat.10:5, Luk.9:52 10:33 17:16, Jhn.4:9, 39-40, Act.8:25; as an opprobrious epithet, Jhn.8:48.†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: Jesus sent these twelve out, and commanded them, saying, “Don’t go among the Gentiles, and don’t enter into any city of the Samaritans.
and sent messengers before his face. They went and entered into a village of the Samaritans, so as to prepare for him.

They therefore, when they had testified and spoken the word of the Lord, returned to Jerusalem, and preached the Good News to many villages of the Samaritans.
